name: tools_raw_trace_scan
description: Scan the raw *.pfw.gz provenance traces of a (live) pipeline in parallel for attribute values (for example mean_plddt of best_structure) without building the TraceViewer index, so a LOCKed or 5+ minute index never blocks an answer. Load when query_summary fails with a RocksDB LOCK, or a question needs an arithmetic mean/count over a very large live run.

history.why: Chat b73b285e4af9 answered "mean pLDDT on the 32 node run" with an ad-hoc python script (/g/g92/haridev/plddt_live/run.py) after the TraceViewer index LOCK killed earlier turns; deterministic repeated work must be a tool, not ad-hoc shell.
